# oneuptime_incident_reminder_rule_data (Data Source)

Incident reminder rule data data source

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "oneuptime_incident_reminder_rule_data" "example" {
  name = "example-incident_reminder_rule_data"
}
```

## Schema

- `id` (String) Identifier to filter by. Optional.
- `name` (String) Name to filter by. Computed.
- `created_at` (String) A date time object.. Computed.
- `updated_at` (String) A date time object.. Computed.
- `deleted_at` (String) A date time object.. Computed.
- `version` (Number) Object version. Computed.
- `project_id` (String) A unique identifier for an object, represented as a UUID.. Computed.
- `description` (String) Description of this reminder rule. Permissions - Create: [Project Owner, Project Admin, Create Incident Reminder Rule], Read: [Project Owner, Project Admin, Project Member, Viewer, Incident Admin, Incident Member, Incident Viewer, Read Incident Reminder Rule], Update: [Project Owner, Project Admin, Edit Incident Reminder Rule]. Computed.
- `order` (Number) Order/priority of this rule. Rules are evaluated in order (lowest first). First matching rule wins.. Permissions - Create: [Project Owner, Project Admin, Create Incident Reminder Rule], Read: [Project Owner, Project Admin, Project Member, Viewer, Incident Admin, Incident Member, Incident Viewer, Read Incident Reminder Rule], Update: [Project Owner, Project Admin, Edit Incident Reminder Rule]. Computed.
- `stop_reminders_on_state` (String) Stop sending reminders once the incident reaches this state.
